clues: This town is on Guatemala's Pacific coast. Its shore looks out on the wide ocean.
The wet season brings rain from May to October. A dry season then runs from November to April.
For hundreds of years, ships used this port for Guatemala. Then a new port to the east took over.
Most visitors here are weekend crowds who come from Guatemala City. The tourist trade here lives off those short trips.
This is the largest town on the whole Pacific coast of Guatemala. No other town on that coast is as big as this one.
